rulebook-v1.0.txt.before: These probabilities apply before Luck Enhancement.
rulebook-v1.0.txt.after:
These probabilities apply before Luck Enhancement. This power-fantasy table governs FUTURE standard random rarity rolls, including new rolls in ongoing campaigns. Preserve issued offers, recorded outcomes and owned rarities. Class-inherited powers and fixed-grade milestones keep their own existing rules; starting equipment uses its separate class-budgeted table.

A major earned quest or chapter payoff may precommit a fixed UNIQUE System reward independently of these random odds. Establish the reward and attainable completion condition before the quest is undertaken; deliver it once when genuinely earned. Keep System rewards separate from NPC contract payment. Respect established world facts and original promised rewards.

rulebook-v1.0.txt.before: Talent rarity, Skill Evolution rarity, item rarity, title rarity, signature skill rarity, background rarity, and class rarity are distinct records. Higher-rarity offers must introduce mechanically meaningful differences appropriate to the source and level. Avoid a guaranteed high-rarity reward merely because a boss is important unless that fixed rarity was established as a true quest or treasure fact. The natural rarity odds and one-tier Luck Enhancement are unchanged.
rulebook-v1.0.txt.after: Talent rarity, Skill Evolution rarity, item rarity, title rarity, signature skill rarity, background rarity, and class rarity are distinct records. Higher-rarity offers must introduce mechanically meaningful differences appropriate to the source and level. Avoid a guaranteed high-rarity reward merely because a boss is important unless that fixed rarity was established as a true quest or treasure fact. The current Chapter 5 natural rarity table and one-tier Luck Enhancement govern.
